intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Kent for 2026, and here is what he found: 7 family events, 4 of them free. New in this update: The Santa House at Kent Station (from November 28), Santa at Carpinito Brothers Christmas Trees (from December 5) and Magical Strings Celtic Yuletide Concert at Kent-Meridian Performing Arts Center (December 6). We check every date on the host’s own website or an official city calendar, and each listing links straight there. For the rest of the state, see our Washington Christmas events for kids guide.

Planning a bigger day out? Kent families also use our guide to Christmas events for kids in Seattle, which covers Seattle Center Winterfest, WildLanterns, the North Pole Limited Santa train and more.

What Rally found in Kent

  • 7 Christmas events for kids in Kent
  • 4 free to attend
  • Meet Santa: The Santa House at Kent Station (from November 28) and Santa at Carpinito Brothers Christmas Trees (from December 5)
  • Also on the list: 1 show, 1 light display and 1 craft or cookie event
  • New events in this update run November 28 to December 30
  • Every date checked on the host’s own site or an official city calendar on Nov 26
